title: Forgetting supports commutes with the canonical exterior product
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:X→S,g:Y→S scheme morphisms, i:Z→X,j:W→Y closed immersions, and K,L arbitrary unbounded etale A-module complexes. Compose the supported pairing [def-pur-supported-exterior-product] with the map forgetting product support, obtained by right deriving the support-kernel inclusion. This equals the tensor of the two source forgetful maps followed by the canonical ordinary absolute pairing [def-pur-ordinary-kunneth-absolute-map]. The assertion is an equality of the actual maps, not only of their induced cohomology maps. No invertibility, finiteness, Tor-amplitude or field hypothesis is required.

proof.text: The supported adjunction is normalized by the quotient from constant coefficients: composing the inverse Hom bijection with that quotient gives the ordinary constant/global-sections Hom bijection after the kernel inclusion. Apply this to the two evaluations. The coefficient tensor comparison is normalized by its composite with the product quotient, so the two underived coefficient/evaluation composites give the same ordinary section pairing.

On cochain complexes this equation holds after each bidegree inclusion, with the same totalization signs. Localize the equation through the exact-functor comparisons and tensor localization counits. The derived coefficient comparisons are uniquely fixed by naturality and their cochain-model equations, so the derived quotient square commutes. The derived adjunctions inherit the corresponding counit normalization from the derived universal property.

Transpose this square under the constant/global-sections derived adjunction. One side is the supported exterior product followed by the right-derived kernel inclusion, and the other is the tensor of the two source inclusions followed by the specified ordinary exterior product. The Hom bijection is injective, giving the asserted equality. This is the final sentence of the blueprint definition; arbitrary K-flat and K-injective models give the same argument for unbounded complexes.

theorem supportedExteriorProduct_forget
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {S X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : W ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    supportedExteriorProduct A f g i j K L ≫
        (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatTrans
          (supportedEtaleSectionsι A (pullback f g)
            (supportedProductImmersion f g i j).openComplement)).app
              (externalProduct (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f g K L) =
      tensorHom
          ((Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatTrans
            (supportedEtaleSectionsι A X i.openComplement)).app K)
          ((Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatTrans
            (supportedEtaleSectionsι A Y j.openComplement)).app L) ≫
        ordinaryGlobalKunnethMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (pullback.fst f g) (pullback.snd f g) K L
